method: Independent nanosecond CSV parsing and phase pairing, filename millisecond origin; no production parser imported. Rebuild phase-anchored 6s/1s windows; read BDF annotations and actual samples. Apply exactly loso.load argsort to cache t/y/blk. float32 time ULP tolerance; sample boundaries checked separately.
metric_note: No model scores or training in this audit; AUC/F1 not computed.
limitation: Confirms correspondence to supplied raw events, not truth of experimental event logging or score polarity. Sample rounding may include up to half a sample before nominal phase onset.
